# WheelFor

> WheelFor is a free online spinning wheel maker for random decisions. Type in a list of options, spin the wheel, and get a random pick — no account or signup required.

## What it does

- Create a custom wheel from any list of options (names, foods, tasks, prizes, and more)
- Spin animation with genuine randomization — every option has an equal chance of winning
- Choose from several high-contrast color themes
- Every wheel gets a shareable link; anyone with the link can spin it without creating an account
- Creators get an edit key so they can update their wheel later

## Pages

- [Homepage](https://wheelfor.com/): build and spin a new wheel
- [Contact](https://wheelfor.com/contact): contact info
- [Privacy Policy](https://wheelfor.com/privacy-policy): privacy policy

## Notes

- Individual wheels are published at https://wheelfor.com/wheel/{slug} — see https://wheelfor.com/wheels-sitemap.xml for the current list of public wheels
- Common uses: picking a random winner or name, classroom activities, team decisions, game night, deciding what to eat, and other group decisions
